# lightdash_ai_provider_credentials (Data Source)

Lists organization AI provider credentials (metadata only; keys are not exposed). Includes `legacy_bedrock` when the organization still has a pre-named-credential Bedrock configuration.

Requires an organization admin personal access token.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash organization.

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) Named AI provider credentials in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `id` (String) Data source identifier: `organizations/<organization_uuid>/ai_provider_credentials`.
- `legacy_bedrock` (Attributes) Legacy Bedrock configuration when present. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--legacy_bedrock))

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `ai_provider` (String)
- `allowed_models` (List of String)
- `api_key_hint` (String)
- `credential_uuid` (String)
- `inference_geography` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `label` (String)
- `region` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--legacy_bedrock"></a>
### Nested Schema for `legacy_bedrock`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_models` (List of String)
- `api_key_hint` (String)
- `region` (String)
